# Private B6O-T Structured Phase-Bridge Minimality Audit

Status: local/private screen only. No publication, commit, stage, or push was performed.

Question: Which minimal ingredients of the structured phase bridge are required for B6O-R intersection access?

Boundary: C-state is fixed as side+tfc+phase. FES is not added as a label; it only supplies bridge phase/order transitions.

- true72 robust/strong: 8 / 8 of 8
